name: Conditional repurposing of employment-derived access

attribution.legal_posture: The source gives a conditional aggregate risk assessment covering a potential handoff to a named intrusion team or a completed named-case intrusion; establishment of either event requires corroborating evidence.

caveats: The record describes reported conduct by specific fraudulent workers; theft, extortion, espionage, persistence, and sabotage remain case-specific.

Fraudulent employment, post-hire insider abuse, fake-interview malware, and external intrusion remain separate analytic tracks unless a source expressly establishes same-case overlap.

statements: Dutch, Microsoft and Sophos reporting treats legitimate employment access as a contingent pathway to sensitive information, espionage, persistence or access reuse by other DPRK activity.
